stories.title: Source: Colts, Adetomiwa Adebawore agree to 2-year, $35M extension
stories.summary: The Colts and defensive tackle Adetomiwa Adebawore have agreed to terms on a two-year, $35 million extension, a source told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo.
stories.detail: The Indianapolis Colts and defensive tackle Adetomiwa Adebawore have agreed to terms on a two-year, $35 million extension, a source told NFL Network's Mike Garafolo on Tuesday. The deal, negotiated by agent Kenny Zuckerman of Priority Sports, includes a $13 million signing bonus and $22.5 million in new money through 2027. The Colts rebuffed trade interest in Adebawore and instead finalized the extension with the defensive tackle, who has already matched his career high with four sacks in just eight games this season. The Colts, who fired general manager Chris Ballard earlier this month, have already traded guard Quenton Nelson (to the Seattle Seahawks ) and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner (to the San Francisco 49ers ) as they begin a rebuild amid a 2-6 start. The Colts are engaged in trade talks with multiple teams regarding star running back Jonathan Taylor , sources have told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. Josh Downs , the team's top wide receiver with Alec Pierce currently on injured reserve, has also requested a trade. stories.title: Saints release former All-Pro K Daniel Carlson after another missed FG in loss to Steelers
stories.summary: Carlson is a nine-year NFL veteran who was named All-Pro twice with the Raiders in 2021 and 2022.
stories.detail: The New Orleans Saints are on the kicker market. The Saints announced on Tuesday that they have released veteran kicker Daniel Carlson after Carlson missed another field goal in Sunday’s 16-10 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. Carlson missed a 52-yard attempt with 9:42 remaining that would have cut Pittsburgh’s lead to 16-13. He finished the game hitting 1 of 2 field-goal attempts, dropping his season success rate on field goals to a career-low 66.7% (8 of 12). Carlson hit all of this field goals up to 49 yards with the Saints, but was 3 of 7 on attempts from 50-plus yards. His release ends his tenure with the Saints after seven games. Carlson, 31, is a nine-year NFL veteran who was named All-Pro twice with the Raiders in 2021 and 2022. He spent seven-plus seasons with the Raiders before joining the Saints in the offseason. The Saints are coming off a Week 8 bye and will need to replace Carlson before facing the Cleveland Browns on Sunday. New Orleans comes out of its by at 2-5, in last place in the NFC Soutyh.

stories.title: Cardinals officially place Jeremiyah Love, Kendrick Bourne on IR
stories.summary: The Cardinals made the move of running back Jeremiyah Love to injured reserve official on Tuesday.
stories.detail: The Cardinals made the move of running back Jeremiyah Love to injured reserve official on Tuesday. He will miss at least the next four games with his new ankle injury. Love missed two games with a left ankle injury before returning against the Cowboys on Sunday. He now has a high ankle sprain in his right ankle. Wide receiver Kendrick Bourne also went on the injured reserve list Tuesday. He has a broken tibia that will end his season. The Cardinals signed rookie wide receiver Harrison Wallace III from the practice squad to the active roster in a corresponding move. The Cardinals also re-signed veteran tight end Rivaldo Fairweather to the practice squad. Fairweather, who was with the team in training camp, replaces practice squad tight end Kenny Yeboah. Yeboah, who was elevated for Sunday's game, went on the IR/practice squad on Tuesday. The Cardinals released defensive lineman Cam Horsley from the practice squad.

stories.title: Saints release Daniel Carlson, claim Audric Estime off waivers
stories.summary: An offensive player is returning to New Orleans.
stories.detail: An offensive player is returning to New Orleans. But to make it happen, the Saints have moved on from their kicker. New Orleans announced on Tuesday that Daniel Carlson has been released and running back Audric Estime has been claimed off waivers. Cleveland let Estime go on Monday. In his first season with New Orleans, Carlson made just 8-of-12 field goals in seven games. All four misses came on attempts of at least 50 yards. He missed a 52-yard attempt during the fourth quarter of the Saints’ Week 7 loss to the Steelers in Paris. Irish kicker Charlie Smyth, who appeared in six games for the Saints last year, is on the team’s practice squad. Estime had been with the Saints since midway through last season before being waived in September with an injury settlement. He joined the Vikings’ practice squad and then was signed to the Browns’ 53-man roster last month. He appeared in one game for Cleveland, taking nine carries for 19 yards with a touchdown in the team’s Oct. 18 win over the Ravens.

stories.title: Seven players have 2027-28 rookie contract options declined
stories.summary: Another three players were outright waived by teams, while 19 had their options picked up.
stories.detail: Missing in the first round of an NBA Draft is a setback in team building, but for seven teams this year it was better to accept the pain now rather than keep the player around for the final year of their rookie deal. Seven players did not have their rookie-scale team options for the 2027-28 season picked up, the deadline was Monday. stories.title: Dumonts take over as controlling owners of Mavericks
stories.summary: Sivan and Patrick Dumont purchased Miriam Adelson's shares of the Mavericks last month, making the Dumont family the controlling owners of the franchise.
stories.detail: Sivan and Patrick Dumont purchased Miriam Adelson's shares of the Dallas Mavericks last month, making the Dumont family the controlling owners of the franchise with a 69% share. Adelson has had minimal involvement with the Mavericks since she bought the majority share of the franchise from Mark Cuban in December 2023 along with her daughter and son-in-law. Patrick Dumont has served as the Mavericks' governor since the families took control of the franchise. "It's really about long-term investment in the city of Dallas," Dumont told ESPN on Tuesday. "The Dumont family is really committed to building what we hope is the best arena in the NBA, a really significant investment in the city that will help create the new 40-year home for the Dallas Mavericks, a great experience for our fans and inspire our team to win championships. That's really what we're focused on. We had the opportunity, and we're really excited about it." Cuban, who has expressed regret about selling the Mavericks to Adelson and the Dumonts due to being frozen out of the franchise's basketball and business operations, maintains a 27% share of the franchise. (Jerome and the Cavaliers would win the title the next season.) He played two seasons with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in Oklahoma City . He played one season with Stephen Curry in Golden State . Something front offices around the league are surely aware of by now: Jerome can become an unrestricted free agent next summer. Jerome, a starting guard for ESPN's Contract Year All-Stars, headlines a 12-player roster full of potential impact free agents, many of whom are searching for massive paydays in the 2027 offseason.
